$comment: Schema of the values of FOCA app charts based on foca-common: copy it to the app chart as values.schema.json and add the app values key, e.g., "petstore": {"$ref": "#/$defs/app"}

not.$comment: Rejects all-zero quantities (Go regular expressions have no lookahead)

tmpSizeLimit.description: Size limit of the emptyDir at /tmp: a positive Kubernetes quantity (e.g., 64Mi) or number of bytes; none if null

image.description: App image repository, optionally with a tag or digest

imagePullPolicy.description: Pull policy of the app image; Always if not set

tag.description: App image tag; defaults to the chart's appVersion

enabled.description: Create an Ingress; otherwise an OpenShift Route, if the cluster serves route.openshift.io/v1

className.description: Ingress class; the cluster's default class if empty

annotations.description: Annotations of the Ingress; take precedence over those set by the chart, null removes them

enabled.description: Request a certificate from cert-manager and serve HTTPS
Create a NetworkPolicy allowing connections to the app only from ingressFrom

ingressFrom.description: NetworkPolicy peers allowed to connect to the app (by default, the namespace ingress-nginx); must not be empty

podSecurityContext.description: Security context of the pod (runAsUser, runAsGroup and fsGroup are omitted on OpenShift)

securityContext.description: Security context of the container (runAsUser and runAsGroup are omitted on OpenShift)

preStopSleepSeconds.description: Seconds that the app keeps serving after its pod is deleted (preStop hook); 0 omits the hook

gunicorn.description: Settings of Gunicorn, the WSGI server of the app image (via GUNICORN_CMD_ARGS); omit them if the image does not run Gunicorn

workers.description: Worker processes; each loads the whole app

timeout.description: Seconds after which workers whose main loop does not respond are restarted (slow requests in threads do not count)

gracefulTimeout.description: Seconds that workers get to finish requests on shutdown; the termination grace period is this plus preStopSleepSeconds plus 10 seconds

keepalive.description: Seconds after which idle keep-alive connections are closed (0: no keep-alive); longer than the upstream keep-alive timeout of the ingress controller (60 for ingress-nginx)

extraArgs.description: Further Gunicorn options (no single quotes); --bind/-b, --preload and --graceful-timeout are rejected

resources.description: Resource requests and limits of the container

app.description: Settings of the app container (under the key of the app chart, e.g., cloudRegistry)

nameOverride.description: Replaces the chart name in resource names and labels; set at installation only

fullnameOverride.description: Replaces the name of the app resources (MongoDB resources get the suffix -mongodb); set at installation only

hostName.description: Public host name of the app (of the Ingress or Route)

config.description: App config overriding the base config in the image (merged by FOCA)

max_content_length.description: Size limit of request bodies, in bytes; also sets that of ingress-nginx

enabled.description: Deploy the bundled MongoDB; if false, set config.db.host (and port) of an external one

image.description: MongoDB image, pinned to a patch version or digest

imagePullPolicy.description: Pull policy of the MongoDB image; Always if not set

existingSecret.description: Secret with the MongoDB credentials (keys username and password, and root-username and root-password for the bundled MongoDB); required if authentication is enabled

enabled.description: Create a NetworkPolicy allowing connections to MongoDB only from the app's pods

podSecurityContext.description: Security context of the pod (runAsUser, runAsGroup and fsGroup are omitted on OpenShift)

securityContext.description: Security context of the container (runAsUser and runAsGroup are omitted on OpenShift)

volumeSize.description: Size of the data volume (a Kubernetes quantity, e.g., 1Gi)

resources.description: Resource requests and limits of the container

enabled.description: Deploy a Celery worker with the app's image; requires broker.existingSecret

command.description: Command of the worker's container; required if enabled

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe of the worker's container; none if empty

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe of the worker's container; none if empty

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds that the worker gets to finish running tasks on shutdown

resources.description: Resource requests and limits of the container

enabled.description: Deploy RabbitMQ as the Celery broker (queued tasks are lost when its pod is replaced); requires existingSecret

existingSecret.description: Secret with the broker URL (key broker-url), optionally the result backend (result-backend) and, for the bundled broker, its user's credentials (username and password); passed to the app and the worker

image.description: RabbitMQ image, pinned to a patch version or digest

imagePullPolicy.description: Pull policy of the RabbitMQ image; Always if not set

enabled.description: Create a NetworkPolicy allowing connections to the broker only from the app's and the worker's pods

podSecurityContext.description: Security context of the pod (runAsUser, runAsGroup and fsGroup are omitted on OpenShift)

securityContext.description: Security context of the container (runAsUser and runAsGroup are omitted on OpenShift)

resources.description: Resource requests and limits of the container

dataSizeLimit.description: Size limit of the emptyDir with the broker's data: a positive Kubernetes quantity (e.g., 1Gi) or number of bytes; none if null
